tough_skin.name: Tough Skin
tough_skin.description: Thick hide grants +1 DEF at all times.

thorns.name: Thorns
thorns.description: Reflect DEF damage back to any attacker that hits you.

deadly_precision.name: Deadly Precision
deadly_precision.description: 20% chance to deal double damage on your attack.

venomous.name: Venomous
venomous.description: Your hits poison the enemy for 1 damage per round over 2 rounds.

swift.name: Swift
swift.description: Light on your feet: +1 SPD at all times.

arcane_mind.name: Arcane Mind
arcane_mind.description: Focused study grants +1 ATQ at all times.

life_tap.name: Life Tap
life_tap.description: Heal for 25% of the damage your attacks deal.
